systems.owner: The Government, which the Code du Numérique of 13 March 2023 charges with setting it up
systems.tiers: Public administrations at central and provincial level, as the law states it; no commune or other local government office is named

note: A law, passages only: it obliges the Government to set up a secure infrastructure for passing information between public administrations at central and provincial level, as a government or provincial intranet; it states an obligation and not that any such network exists, and puts no local government office on it, so no fact of class connection.
